limits: Natural GC remains enabled; copied survivors are excluded.
Counts include dead allocations and host-bridge work; they do not measure live heap.
Physical types do not identify semantic/source allocation origins.
Validation increment is separate from the request and excludes no request allocation twice.
Per-type medians need not sum to the median total.
Each diagnostic process runs sync then async in one retained Realm; timing cohorts are case-isolated.
Diagnostic timings and native-cache setup are not scored.

qualification.limits: Affected integration/source scopes only. Full CI, pinned Test262 and private units were not rerun. Existing unmodified formatting and Intl identity gates remain owned.

evidence_archive.policy: Regular UTF-8 evidence only; no native executables, Wasm, perf.data or cache blobs. SHA256 INDEX covers every evidence member.
